$comment: §29 and §30. The contract, with no entries, because no corpus exists.

entry_fields.note: an exact origin or an explicitly stated scope; never an unbounded pattern
what the reason rests on: a retrieved statement, operator correspondence, or a recorded operator decision

freeze.an_exclusion_added_mid_run: recorded as an explicit event; the pre-run manifest is not rewritten
freeze.why: a manifest edited after the fact would make the run's own record disagree with what it measured, and the disagreement would be invisible.

why_empty: no corpus exists, so there is no target to exclude. An entry invented here would be a governance decision about a site nobody has proposed measuring.
